C9000266.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 266 (Exactly three mutually unbiased bases in dimension six.; papers: The maximum number of mutually unbiased bases in dimension six; Exact Fourier certificates for complex Hadamard matrices of order six; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/266.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_PAIR_IDENTITY.statement: For every unimodular H with H*H=6I and either stated q, 3<|L|^2>+<|g(alpha)g(q)|^2>=0 (prop:pair-certificate).

C_MOMENT_SYMMETRIES.statement: Real injective moments averaged over H and H transpose are invariant under row/column permutations, zero-axis deletion, global negation and transposition.

C_CONTRACTION.statement: (7-p)m(A)=-sum merged moments for p<=6, and the sum of six merged moments is zero for a formal seven-row array with an order-one row.

C_CONTRACTION_BRIDGE.statement: An orthogonal zero-sum column ratio splits into occupied and unused labels; normalization gives coefficient 6-|used|, and |used|=6 gives the boundary relation without division.

C_PARTITIONS.statement: A zero-total-charge character product expands into injective moments with one weight (6)_k/6^n for each equality partition with k<=6 blocks.

C_PAIR_DUAL.statement: The two exact target expansions are rational linear combinations of valid seven-row boundary equations.

C_POSITIVITY.statement: Positive finite averaging of the two nonnegative identities yields both pointwise product vanishings; a nonzero alpha partition then forces every squared-row inner product to vanish.

C_DICHOTOMY.statement: For every order-six complex Hadamard, either every permuted alpha character vanishes or its entrywise square is Hadamard.

C_CUBIC_CLASSIFICATION.statement: If H and H entrywise-squared are order-six Hadamards, H is equivalent to Tao's cubic matrix (prop:cubic-classification); not audited in this mission.

C_FOURIER.statement: Outside Tao's equivalence class, every permuted alpha character vanishes (thm:fourier).

C_COMPLETE_IDENTITIES.statement: Seven mutually unbiased bases imply the order-two sum, same-matrix and different-matrix character identities (lem:basic); unaudited.

C_CUBIC_EXCLUSION.statement: No transition in a complete seven-basis family has Hadamard entrywise square (prop:cubic-exclusion); unaudited.

C_MIXED_REDUCTIONS.statement: Under complete-family alpha vanishing, the shared-column Gram entries and mixed-moment reductions have the stated semantics and coefficients; unaudited.

C_EXACT_SUBSTITUTIONS.statement: The modular nonsingular pivot minor and exact WP=0 identity imply valid rational substitutions for every real solution (lem:exact-elimination); unaudited and not trusted by the new direct-dual checker.

C_MIXED_CERTIFICATE.statement: The six positive forms have upper bound -2007321335237/30 under the mixed identities (prop:mixed-certificate); unaudited.

C_NO_SEVEN.statement: There are no seven mutually unbiased bases in complex dimension six (companion thm:main); unaudited outside its pair-certificate input.

C_WEINER_COMPLETION.statement: Any d mutually unbiased bases in complex dimension d extend to d+1 bases (cited Weiner Corollary 3.4); unaudited, not used in this mission.

C_AT_MOST_FIVE.statement: N(6)<=5 as a consequence of the companion no-seven theorem and completion theorem; unaudited.

C_MAIN_SEED.statement: Every extendible order-six Hadamard has an equivalent seed in a generated closed nine-phase seed ball (seed:cover); unaudited.

C_MAIN_COMPLETION.statement: Successful prescribed U(2) covering and arithmetic margins represent every exact completion by a coarse Record (phase:A-cover); unaudited.

C_MAIN_REFINEMENT.statement: Certified refinement and batch enlargement preserve coverage of every exact solution (refine:cover-preservation and refine:batch-cover); unaudited.

C_MAIN_EXCLUSION.statement: Under root and rounding certificates, a negative Stage C excludes every four-basis extension in its closed Record ball (exclude:local-certificate); unaudited.

C_MAIN_ARITHMETIC.statement: The specified compiler/binary64 conditions and error estimates certify all outward bounds used by the main numerical construction; unaudited.

C_MAIN_EXECUTION.statement: All stipulated terminal, provenance, coverage and batch checks actually hold for the main computation (execute:control); not authenticated or rerun.

C_MAIN_NO_FOUR.statement: The complete-execution contract implies no four mutually unbiased bases in complex dimension six (execute:finite-theorem); remains open.

C_THREE_BASES.statement: Three mutually unbiased bases exist in complex dimension six, for example by tensoring dimension-two and dimension-three constructions; lower-bound input not audited in this mission.

C_MAIN_EXACT_THREE.statement: N(6)=3 requires both the no-four theorem and the existence of three bases; neither follows from this Fourier milestone alone.

C_CUBIC_SYMMETRY.statement: Every row permutation of Tao's matrix extends to the specified phased, possibly conjugated symmetry (lem:cubic-symmetry); unaudited.

C_CUBIC_COUNTS.statement: The cube-root and orbit counts give the stated R multipliers and S_0=-4/5 contradiction for the cubic-pair obstruction (tab:cubic-counts); unaudited.

C_SHARED_COLUMN_GRAM.statement: A single auxiliary sampled column yields the three-factor Gram identities with weights 1/5 and 4/5 (lem:gram); unaudited.

C_MIXED_POSITIVITY.statement: All 98 exact Schur pivots of the six specified integer matrices exceed 40000, proving their positive definiteness; unaudited.
